description: This file is a shell script used for testing session ID handling in a Git protocol implementation. It contains setup commands, test cases for fetching and pushing with and without session IDs, and configuration adjustments to control advertisement of session IDs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after the test.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the specified repository.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
